title: Red–Green Alliance (Denmark)
extract: The Red–Green Alliance, or Unity List, is an eco-socialist political party in Denmark. It was founded in 1989 with the merger of three Marxist parties, and is the most left-wing party in the Folketing, where it advocates for the expansion of the welfare state and social justice as well as the socialist transformation of Denmark and the entire globe. During the 2021 Copenhagen City Council election the party placed first, with 24.6% of the votes. The party is also active in various trade unions within Denmark.
